verdict.rationale: Official Claude mobile apps exist on both platforms: an iOS install guide points to 'Claude by Anthropic' in the App Store, the homepage lists 'Chat on web, iOS, Android, and on your desktop', and voice mode is documented on Claude Mobile for iOS and Android and built to work best from a phone. Missing for 10: a dedicated Android install doc, documentation of which features beyond voice mode (e.g. projects, file uploads, connectors) work on mobile, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile app quality.
